metadata.investigationConclusion: API GET /public/members/:memberId already returns all visibility=public fields via publicSections; no API/D1/Form schema change is needed. The 'thin' symptom is caused by (A) apps/web adapter+components rendering publicSections as a flat KV list instead of the prototype's structured sections, and (B) the TEST-MEM-01 seed carrying only 3 fields. Both are fixed in apps/web (adapter/components) and apps/api (test-accounts seed) within one cycle.
lanes: Lane A (web UI): rebuild apps/web/src/lib/adapters/member-detail.ts into stableKey-driven section reconstruction and rework public components into prototype-compliant Hero/BusinessOverview/Tags+Links/Personal/Message sections.
Lane B (api seed): extend apps/api/src/testing/test-accounts seed so TEST-MEM-01 (and representative peers) carry all visibility=public survey answers, enabling staging full-field verification.
